    if not four or not six:

    for r, c in six:
        out[r][c] = 0
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in four), max(r for r, c in four)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in four), max(c for r, c in four)
    sr0, sr1 = min(r for r, c in six), max(r for r, c in six)
    sc0, sc1 = min(c for r, c in six), max(c for r, c in six)
    row_counts = [sum(r == rr for r, c in six) for rr in range(sr0, sr1 + 1)]
    col_counts = [sum(c == cc for r, c in six) for cc in range(sc0, sc1 + 1)]
    # A T-shaped marker (broad end at top or bottom) indicates horizontal
